pulse.currentFocus: Session 324 swept the build-script verification gates as a class and found twelve that no runner in the project ever invoked. A gate nothing asks is indistinguishable from a gate that passed, and three of these twelve had been failing quietly: the public plain-English changelog, the machine-readable map that tells AI agents which page answers which question, and the public statistics surface were all a build behind on the live site, while the headline verification number read three hundred nineteen of three hundred nineteen green every session. All three feeds are current again, and the reason they could go stale is closed: seven scheduled publishers were committing a source feed without re-deriving the page or feed that reads it. Two more gates reported a failure state as a success and now stop the build instead. A new structural check proves every verification gate is reachable from the verification suite, so the next one cannot be born unmeasured. The full suite passes three hundred twenty-seven of three hundred twenty-seven.
pulse.nextMilestone: One founder sign-in ceremony to record the real-provider journey and clear the production hold on member accounts, then extend the new reachability check to the remaining script families and give the velocity feed a window-anchored drift gate.
blockers: content promotion still depends on a route-provenance probe run from an unchallenged vantage for the PRODUCTION half of the receipt: CI is bot-challenged at the production origin and cannot produce the live route evidence the split-release guard requires. (A CI-reachable build-attestation vantage was added session 322 but deliberately cannot satisfy this gate.)

identity: the provider chain is live and verified (discovery JSON, authorize redirect, JWKS, and the revocation route all answer correctly as of session 321). The production promotion is held only on the real-provider journey, whose remaining leg is a founder passkey ceremony — hardware-key enrollment is founder-reserved by CANON-019 and is deliberately not automatable.
rollback architecture: the GitHub Pages warm origin still follows mutable main; D-S303 requires explicit founder authorization before migrating to an immutable verified generation.
IGNIS freshness: stale in a studio-ops portfolio artifact this repo cannot write; resolve upstream rather than backdating.
The Dispatch has zero confirmed subscribers until the founder clicks the double-opt-in confirmation email.

now: [S321][FOUNDER/P0] Run the real-provider sign-in ceremony — it is now the ONLY thing holding production promotion. `node scripts/verify-provider-journey.mjs --live` opens a headed Chromium at `/login`; the founder completes the passkey ceremony (~2 min, the script never sees the credential) and the script then observes all five journey legs itself. The external chain was verified live in S321 and receipted at `api/provider-chain-readiness.json` (`chainReady: true`): discovery serves JSON, `/login` 302s with a full S256 PKCE challenge, JWKS publishes a key, and `/auth/revoke` answers 401 `invalid_client`. This is no longer blocked on a sibling repo. Hardware-key enrollment is CANON-019 founder-reserved — do not automate it and do not schedule it unattended (it waits 10 minutes and times out). Do NOT hand-write any `providerJourney` leg; `verify-provider-journey.mjs` is their sole writer and that exclusivity is why the receipt is trustworthy.

[S321→S322][SIL][RELEASE/P1] Wire the staging `workers_dev` binding as the route-provenance corroborating vantage. ✅ (S322) `build-worker-route-provenance.mjs --probe` now also probes `https://vaultspark-security-headers-staging.founder-d73.workers.dev` and writes a `buildVantage` field (`attests: "build"`, own state/summary/sourceSha256) alongside the primary receipt. CI's existing `--probe` step in `uptime-probe.yml` picks it up with no workflow change. Deliberately additive: `observedOrigin`, `routes[]`, and `state` on the primary receipt are untouched, so `check-content-capability-slice.mjs`'s `observedOrigin === production` gate still requires the real thing — a build attestation can never stand in for production route provenance. self-test 19/19 (6 new cases) · build:check 319/319.

[S321→S323][SIL][GATE/P1] Audit the remaining gate names against what they actually assert. ✅ (S323) Swept all 173 `check-*.mjs` gates (five in-process reader agents), verified each candidate against live code, and fixed ten offenders — most severe: `check-worker-rewriter-safety` ran 2 of the 4 unsafe-op scanners it defines (nonce-`Content-Type`-drop + HEAD-cache-poison dead in production, green in self-test); `check-canon-compliance` CANON-008 passed on a canon-id substring the propagated index always carries; `check-launch-ready` compared case-sensitive `'SPARKED'` vs the registry's lowercase `'sparked'`, silently disabling all SPARKED enforcement, and read `liveUrl` where the field is `runtimeUrl`. Also fixed: news-engagement engaged-time drift, build-step unguarded-read blindness, game-playability sourceRepo-in-loop, registry-freshness dead urlDrift bucket, hero-jsonld empty-array truthiness, journal-dates comma≠day, portfolio-coherence phantom sitemap leg. Each fix locked by a both-directions self-test. build:check 319/319 (real captured exit — the wrapper's "exit 0" masked a real exit 1 first run).

[S323→S324][SIL][GATE/P2] Swept the `build-*.mjs --check` gates as a class — the defect was worse than predicted. ✅ (S324) The predicted shapes (volatile-input drift, absent-input-defaults-green) were rare. The real class defect was gates nothing ever invokes: of 82 `build-*.mjs --check` implementations, 54 were wired into `build:check:steps`, 16 reached one hop in through `check-proof-surface` / `check-generated-drift-preflight`, and 12 were reachable by no runner at all. Run individually, three were RED — `api/changelog-narrative.json`, `api/intent-map.json`, and `data/stats-surface.json`+`stats.json` were all stale on the live site while `build:check` read 319/319 green. Two more gates were name-vs-body: `build-release-dependencies --check` printed `state: rejected` and exited 0, and `build-tt-summary --check` derived the fresh payload then never compared it. All fixed, all locked with both-directions self-tests, and replaced by a structural gate (`check-build-gate-reachability.mjs`) so the next unreachable `--check` cannot be born silently. build:check 327/327 (real captured exit 0).

[S324][SIL][OBS/P2] `api/ecosystem-velocity.json` has no drift gate — an honest, recorded coverage gap. `build-oracle-velocity-public --check` is declared `@check-mode dry-run`: it prints its derived summary and never compares against the committed feed, and cannot, because its source is a moving 60-day `git log` window that would go red on every new commit rather than on a real defect. It is kept current by `npm run build` and the 4-hourly cron. <!-- evidence-open: `npm run build` and the cron are named as the EXISTING mechanisms that keep the feed current — they are why the gap is low-severity, not the deliverable. The deliverable is a window-anchored drift gate that does not exist. --> A real gate would need a window-anchored fingerprint (compare the series for days that are already closed, ignore the moving edge). Not urgent; recorded so it is not mistaken for coverage.

[S324][SIL][GATE/P2] Extend the reachability meta-gate beyond `build-*.mjs`. `check-build-gate-reachability.mjs` proves every `build-*.mjs --check` is reachable from `npm run build:check`. The same question is unasked of the `check-*.mjs`, `generate-*.mjs`, `derive-*.mjs`, and `enrich-*.mjs` families — `check-orphan-scripts` proves a script has *a consumer somewhere*, which is a weaker claim than *this gate runs in the verification suite*. Widen the enumeration; expect the same three-red-gates result. <!-- evidence-open: `build:check` and `check-orphan-scripts` are named as the EXISTING baseline this task must exceed. The deliverable is reachability enumeration for the check/generate/derive/enrich families, which does not exist. -->

[S323][ARK] Ship a `pattern-share` to studio-ops on two launch-ready latent bugs. The registry's canonical live-URL field is `runtimeUrl`, not `liveUrl`; and case-sensitive `vaultStatus === 'SPARKED'` comparisons silently disable SPARKED enforcement portfolio-wide. Both are latent in any sibling that copied the launch-ready / compliance pattern.

[S323][ADVISORY] Surfaced, studio-ops-owned (CANON-018): `mindframe` registry `deployedUrl` drift (local `steadfast-determination-production.up.railway.app` ≠ canonical `usemindframe.com`) and `franchise-architect` portfolio-coherence drift. Resolve upstream, not from here.
next: [NEXT][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet. Add stable fact rows and validated factRefs joining factual evidence to stances and visual anchors; publish a per-story public-safe argument map and one-click critique packet with no runtime model spend.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Field-vitals freshness closure. Surface observed-through/stale-days, restore a fresh post-S262 RUM window, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so fresh generatedAt can never imply fresh field evidence.
